title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations
qco_reference: Central Electricity Authority (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations
notifying_ministry: Ministry of Power / Central Electricity Authority
scope: Covers design, selection, erection, inspection, and testing of electrical installations operating at voltages up to 1000 V A.C. or 1500 V D.C., harmonized with IEC 60364.

supersedes.reason: Superseded by Fourth Revision to align with IEC 60364 and mandate 30 mA RCDs for shock protection and Type 2 SPDs for transient surge protection.

clauses.title: Additional Protection via RCDs
clauses.text: In A.C. systems, additional protection by means of a residual current device (RCD) with rated residual operating current not exceeding 30 mA shall be provided for socket-outlets with rated current not exceeding 32 A.

clauses.title: Protection Against Transient Overvoltages
clauses.text: Protection against transient overvoltages (surges) shall be provided where the consequence caused by overvoltage affects human life or commercial/public activity.

normative_references.description: Code of Practice for Earthing — Earthing arrangements and protective conductors.
